content.title: Partner program
content.description: Early access, training, and leads for agencies and freelancers who build with us.

sections.heading: Grow with our partner program
sections.text: Agencies and freelancers get early access, training, and leads from teams looking for help.

sections.heading: What partners get
sections.text: Support at every stage, from your first project to a dedicated practice.

items.title: Certified training
items.text: Self-paced courses and live workshops for developers and content strategists.

items.title: Qualified leads
items.text: We introduce you to customers who need help in your region and industry.

items.title: Early access
items.text: Try new features before release and shape them with direct feedback.

items.title: Co-marketing
items.text: Case studies, webinars, and a listing in our partner directory.

items.quote: Certification made it easy to staff projects. Clients ask for it by name now.
items.name: Lea Brandt

items.quote: Half of our new projects last year came through partner leads.
items.name: Tom Okafor

items.question: Who can join?
items.answer: Agencies, consultancies, and freelancers who build websites or content platforms for clients.

items.question: What does it cost?
items.answer: Joining is free. Some certifications have an exam fee, which we waive for your first two developers.

items.question: How are leads assigned?
items.answer: We match leads by region, industry, and tier, and you decide whether to take them.

sections.heading: Apply as a partner
sections.text: Tell us about your team and the projects you work on. All fields are required.
sections.success_message: Thanks for applying. Our partner team will contact you within a week.
